name: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk
summary: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk operates as a copper and gold producer in Indonesia. The company holds interests in the Batu Hijau mine and Elang project located on the island of Sumbawa. It also provides metal processing; and manpower supply, training, and other services, as well as operates liquefied natural gas storage and regasification facilities. In addition, the company operates precious metals refinery facilities for copper concentrate. Further, it engages in the real estate, restaurant, hospitality, forest utilization, and airport services activities, as well as offers commercial aircraft transportation services.
